title: Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery, Garni Canyon Symphony of stones
description: This exclusive private tour includes some of the most famous and captivating sites in Armenia. Begin with a visit to the Garni Pagan Temple, dating back to the 1st century, which was dedicated to Mihr, the Sun God. Continuing your journey, marvel at the grandeur of the Geghard Monastery complex, a stunning 13th-century site partially carved into the rock. Recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage site, it is a true architectural masterpiece. Finally, be awe-struck by the natural beauty of Garni Canyon, often referred to as the "Basaltic Organ" for its extraordinary rock formations. This tour offers a perfect blend of Armenia's rich history, culture and breathtaking landscapes.

Afterwards you will have a stop at a special view point and there will be a chance to take nice photos of Azat Reservoir, surrounded with nature. Next on the route is the only pagan temple in Armenia – Garni. And, finally, you will be amazed by the magnificence of the 13th century Geghard monastic complex, partially carved in the rock and included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List.

See Sevanavank monastic complex, located on the peninsula, overlooking the whole beauty of the lake. Currently a religious seminary functions here which is not readily open to the public. Afterwards the route heads to Dilijan, also called "Armenian Switzerland" for its fantastic natural forests. The city is part of the Dilijan National Park. You will stop at the 10th century Haghartsin monastery, which has been recently renovated by donation of Sheikh Dr. Sultan Bin Mohammad Al Qassimi, the Ruler of Sharjah, who was impressed by the monastery when visiting it. At the end of the tour there will be a visit of wonderful Goshavank monastery, surrounded by green forests.

Next, you will visit the Yazidi Temple in Aknalich, known as Quba Mêrê Dîwanê, the largest Yazidi temple globally and a central place for the Yazidi community. The final stop is the Zvartnots Temple, a 7th-century structure that was once among the tallest buildings of its time.

title: Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery, performance of spiritual songs by Luys Vocal Quintet
description: A fantastic way to get an insight view of the history of Armenia! First on the route, visit Garni – the unique survived example of heathen culture in our country and the perfect blend of Greco-Roman and Armenian styles, thus – the only pagan temple in Armenia, dedicated to the God of Sun Mihr. Afterwards see Geghard monastery complex – the unsurpassable masterpiece of the 13th century Armenian architecture, included in UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. Apart from being a top destination for all the visitors of Armenia, Geghard stands for a place with most unique acoustics, thanks to which one can enjoy Armenian medieval spiritual song performances. Within the framework of this very private tour you will have a chance to enjoy those songs by "Luys" vocal quintet. The voices of the performers are rightly described as "harmonious light symphony".

title: Hiking up Mount Azhdahak
description: This place is especially renowned among trained hikers. It is quite a serious challenge to reach the peak of Geghama Ridge, Azhdahak, on foot from the start. But the dared ones are granted with fascinating view to the entire Geghama Ridge along with the feeling of being a conqueror. Usually the very hiking part comes after the trip by off road transport so as to decrease the long walking distance and make the trekking more bearable.

title: Saghmosavank, Hovhannavank, Echmiadzin Mother Cathedral, Museum, Zvartnots
description: This private tour begins with visits to the stunning Saghmosavank and Hovhannavank monasteries, both offering breathtaking views over the Kasakh Gorge. You will also have an opportunity to visit the spiritual center of Armenia – Echmiadzin, the sites of which are included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. The key stop is at the Echmiadzin Mother Cathedral – the main cathedral of the Armenian Apostolic Church and the very first Christian cathedral in the World. Next, the amazing "Treasures of Echmiadzin" museum is there to welcome you. The last stop of the tour is Zvartnots temple of 7th century, one of the tallest buildings of the time.

title: Armenian Alphabet Alley, Hovhannavank Monastery, Mughni Church, Tegher Monastery
description: Start your day with this riveting private tour! Visit Armenian Alphabet Monument – a beautiful demonstration of the stone carvings of 39 Armenian letters, located at the east side bottom of Mount Aragats, in the village of Artashavan. Next is built in the 5th century medieval Hovhanavank monastery, that has once played a significant role in the educational and cultural life of Armenia. Further along the route there will be a stop at domed-basilica style Mughni church, which, according to the legend, was constructed over the relics of St. George in the 17th century. There are great many of architectural ornaments, stones of different colors and frescoes in the church. Last in the program is Tegher monastery, built in the first half of 13th century, offering picturesque views of Byurakan observatory.

title: Flavors of Armenia: Aregi Dry Fruit and Eco-Snack factory, Armenia Wine factory
description: This tour is a great choice for the ones who prefer healthy food of Armenian production and also wine lovers. First you will have a visit to "Aregi" Dry Fruit and Eco-Snack Factory, where incredible combinations of fruits and vegetables await you. "Aregi" products are exclusively without sugar and additives, the factory operates by receiving solar energy through special stations. Thanks to the latter, ecologically clean dry fruit and vegetable snacks-chips are produced, and there will be an opportunity for you to taste. Up next is the visit to one of the largest factories in Armenia – "Armenia Wine" factory. Here you will tour around the cellars, be introduced to the engaging process of wine production, as well as have a tasting of 2 types of "Armenia" wine in a special hall.

title: Sardarapat National Ethnographic Museum
description: One of the significant pages in the history of Armenia is the battle of Sardarapat in 1918, in which the Armenian fighters defeated the Turkish army – many times dominant in number. In memory of this important victory, there was built a memorial complex, the alleys of which lead to the ethnographic and historical museums.

title: Sightseeing and walking tour in Yerevan, Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery
description: We offer you to start your journey across Armenia with a fascinating sightseeing tour of Yerevan, the heart of Armenia. You are going to enjoy interesting stories of the thousand-year history of the capital along with visits of architectural monuments (such as the Opera House, Cascade Complex, National Assembly Building, Republic Square), as well as vintage central streets of the city (such as Abovyan str., Mashtots ave., Baghramyan ave., Northern ave.). Next on the route is the only pagan temple in Armenia – Garni. And, finally, you will be amazed by the magnificence of the 13th century Geghard monastic complex, partially carved in the rock and included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List.

title: Bjni Fortress, Tsaghkadzor Ropeway, Kecharis Monastery, Zipline flight
description: Within the scope of this private tour first visit Bjni to take the view of St. Astvatsatsin monastery, founded in 1031 and the beautiful fotress, located on upland promontory, surrounded by impregnable rocks. Next, have a stop at Tsaghkadzor with visits of Kecharis monastic complex and a cable car to go up the slope of Mount Teghenis (from where there opens a picturesque view of the mountain ranges of the region). Finish the tour with an activity full of adrenaline and emotions – flight on a zipline not far from Kecharis.

title: Echmiadzin Cathedral, St. Hripsime, St. Gayane, Gata making, Voskeni wine factory
description: Get inspired by the rich and deeply rooted culture and history of our country taking this private tour! Visit Echmiadzin – the spiritual center of Armenia, the sites of which are included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. The first stop is considered at the church of St. Gayane, built in honor of the Christian martyr. The key stop will be at the Echmiadzin Mother Cathedral – the main cathedral of the Armenian Apostolic Church and the very first Christian cathedral in the World. The sweet contribution of the tour will be master class of preparation of very popular traditional Armenian pastry – gata. Last, you will enjoy the tour and tasting of sophisticated wines at "Voskeni" wine factory.

title: Khor Virap Monastery, Yerevan sightseeing tour
description: This short tour is perfect choice to fill up a busy day with an interesting journey to the foot of Ararat Mount, where the magnificent Khor Virap monastery is located, and from where there opens a breathtaking view of the Biblical mountain (in cloudless weather). You will appear at the birthplace of Christianity and get acquainted with the fascinating history of its formation as state religion in Armenia in 301. A wonderful private tour around Yerevan – a city 29 years older than Rome! Discover the fascinating sights of Yerevan, the heart of Armenia. You are going to enjoy interesting stories of the thousand-year history of the capital along with observations of the main architectural monuments, as well as vintage central streets of the city. And from the height of the special viewpoint the whole city will open up towards you.

title: St. Hripsime, St. Gayane, Echmiadzin Mother Cathedral, Sardarapat, Zvartnots Temple
description: Within this private tour you will have an opportunity to visit the spiritual center of Armenia – Echmiadzin, the sites of which are included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. The first stops will be at the churches of St. Hripsime and St. Gayane, built in honor of the Christian martyrs who escaped from Rome led by their abbess Gayane. Afterwards there comes the key stop at the Echmiadzin Mother Cathedral – the main cathedral of the Armenian Apostolic Church and the very first Christian cathedral in the World. One of the significant pages in the history of Armenia is the battle of Sardarapat in 1918, in which the Armenian fighters defeated the Turkish army – many times dominant in number. In memory of this important victory, there was built a memorial complex, the alleys of which lead to the ethnographic and historical museums. The last stop of the tour is Zvartnots temple of 7th century, one of the tallest buildings of the time.

title: Hiking up the Southern Peak of Mount Aragats
description: This amazing private tour starts with the visit of Mount Aragats, which has rightly been described as the ''sister" of Biblical Mount Ararat. There are 4 peaks to conquer, for the time being we offer to surmount the Southern peak considered to be more classic and optimal option for wide range of hikers.

title: Lake Sevan, Sevanavank Monastery, Fishing and leisure at the lakeside
description: An interesting private tour, dedicated to the visit of the "Blue pearl" of our mountainous country, one of the largest freshwater high altitude lakes in Eurasia – Lake Sevan. On the hill of the peninsula there stands majestic Sevanavank monastery, opening an amazing view of the lake, shimmering in a palette of blue, emerald and green. Currently a religious seminary functions there which is not readily open to the public. After the visit of the monastery you will have enough time to observe the lake yourself, have fishing, leave the unnecessary thoughts aside and just relax...

title: Saghmosavank Monastery, Alphabet Alley, Amberd Fortress, Oshakan, Karmravor Church
description: This exciting private tour includes visits of some of the most interesting historical monuments of Armenia in Aragatsotn province. The first stop will be at the monastery of Psalms – Saghmosavank, which is located near the Kasakh gorge, then at Armenian Alphabet Monument, where you can take photos with stately stone letters. Amberd fortress of the 7th century, located on the southern slope of Mount Aragats, will amaze you with its history and picturesque location. At the end of the tour program visits of two churches are scheduled: St. Mesrop Mashtots in the village of Oshakan, where the remains of the creator of the Armenian alphabet are buried, as well as Karmravor, which supposedly served as a chapel for one of the princely families of that time.

title: Saghmosavank Monastery, Armenian Alphabet Alley, Armenia Wine factory, ArmAs wine factory
description: This is your chance to discover the wonders of Aragatsotn province! First up, see Saghmosavank – the monastery of Psalms, located near the Kasakh gorge. After there comes the visit of Armenian Alphabet Monument, erected in 2005 to the 1600th anniversary of creation of the Armenian alphabet. There you can take photos with stately stone letters. The second part of the tour is dedicated to savoring truly inspiring assortment of wines at "Armenia Wine" and "ArmAs" wineries along with enjoying palatable dish of Armenian cuisine.

title: Echmiadzin Mother Cathedral, Museum, Zvartnots, Tsaghkadzor, Kecharis, Ropeway
description: Within this private tour you will have an opportunity to visit the spiritual center of Armenia – Echmiadzin, the sites of which are included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. The key stop is at the Echmiadzin Mother Cathedral – the main cathedral of the Armenian Apostolic Church and the very first Christian cathedral in the World. Next, the amazing "Treasures of Echmiadzin" museum is there to welcome you. The following stop of the tour is Zvartnots temple of 7th century, one of the tallest buildings of the time. You will continue the tour to Tsaghkadzor and have the opportunity to visit Kecharis monastic complex and a cable car to go up the slope of Mount Teghenis (from where there opens a picturesque view of the mountain ranges of the region) are foreseen.

title: Amberd Fortress, Mount Aragats, Lake Kari, Dry Fruit production and tasting, Saghmosavank, Alphabet Alley
description: Set off on a journey through the breathtaking landscapes and cultural treasures of Armenia’s Aragatsotn region. This tour blends history, nature, and local traditions for an unforgettable experience. Start with Amberd Fortress, a medieval stronghold perched on the slopes of Mount Aragats, the highest peak in Armenia. Marvel at its imposing stone walls and scenic valley views. Ascend further to Lake Kari, a crystal-clear alpine lake at 3250 meters, where fresh mountain air and serene beauty create a perfect retreat. Next, immerse yourself in Armenian culinary heritage at a dry fruit production facility, where you’ll witness traditional drying techniques and enjoy a tasting of naturally sweet, sun-dried fruits. Continue to Saghmosavank Monastery, a 13th-century architectural masterpiece standing dramatically above the Kasagh River gorge. Known as the "Monastery of Psalms", this spiritual haven has inspired generations of monks and travelers alike. Conclude your journey at Alphabet Alley, a tribute to the Armenian alphabet, where intricately carved stone letters stand as a symbol of the nation’s linguistic and cultural legacy. This tour is a perfect blend of history, nature, and flavors, offering a deep connection to Armenia’s past and present.

title: Khor Virap Monastery, Azat Reservoir view point, Garni Temple, Lavash baking, Geghard Monastery
description: Discover Armenia's rich history, stunning landscapes, and cultural traditions on this immersive tour. Start at Khor Virap Monastery, offering breathtaking views of Mount Ararat and deep historical significance as the site where Saint Gregory the Illuminator was imprisoned. Continue to the serene Azat Reservoir, surrounded by picturesque nature, a perfect spot for capturing scenic beauty. Then, explore Garni Temple, the only surviving Greco-Roman colonnaded temple in the region, a remarkable testament to Armenia's ancient past. Then, experience a hands-on lavash baking master class, learning the traditional method of preparing Armenia's famous flatbread. Conclude at Geghard Monastery, a UNESCO-listed masterpiece partially carved into the rock, known for its spiritual atmosphere, intricate carvings, and sacred relics. This tour blends history, nature, and authentic experiences, offering a deep connection to Armenia's heritage.

title: Echmiadzin Mother Cathedral, Treasures Museum, Zvartnots, Lake Sevan, Sevanavank
description: During this private tour you will visit the spiritual center of Armenia – Echmiadzin, the sites of which are included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. The key stop is at the Echmiadzin Mother Cathedral – the main cathedral of the Armenian Apostolic Church and the very first Christian cathedral in the World. Next, the amazing "Treasures of Echmiadzin" museum is there to welcome you. The last stop of the tour is Zvartnots temple of 7th century, one of the tallest buildings of the time. Continue tour to Lake Sevan, the pearl of our mountainous country and one of the largest freshwater high-altitude lakes in Eurasia. See Sevanavank monastic complex, located on the peninsula, overlooking the whole beauty of the lake.

title: Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery, Tsaghkadzor Ropeway, Kecharis Monastery
description: Comprising two directions at once, this private tour is a perfect choice for those who have planned a short trip around Armenia. The first stop is going to be at the only pagan temple in Armenia – Garni, and at 20-minutes' drive from the temple you will be amazed by the magnificence of the 13th century Geghard monastic complex, partially carved in the rock and included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. In Tsaghkadzor visits of Kecharis monastic complex and a cable car to go up the slope of Mount Teghenis (from where there opens a picturesque view of the mountain ranges of the region) are foreseen.

title: Hiking up Tsaghkunyats Ridge
description: Feel free to add this destination in your travel plan: hiking to Tsaghkunyats Ridge is quite suitable for those who have little or no experience in climbing. While walking, in front of you there will open a stunning view to the ridge and surrounding mountains, conveying unforgettable feelings and impression.

title: Lake Sevan, Noratus, Mikayelyan Family Farm, Sevanavank Monastery
description: It's an enjoyable private tour during which first you will have a short stop near Lake Sevan – one of the largest freshwater high-altitude lakes in Eurasia. Next, you will see the most original manifestation of Armenian medieval culture – cross-stones, visiting Noratus. By the way, Armenian cross-stones art is included in UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. Last, learn about Armenian cheesemaking process, traditions, taste various cheese types at "Mikayelyan" Family Farm.

title: Khor Virap Monastery, Tsaghkadzor, Kecharis Monastery, Ropeway
description: This is an interesting journey to the foot of Ararat Mount, where the magnificent Khor Virap monastery is located, and from where there opens a breathtaking view of the Biblical mountain (in cloudless weather). You will appear at the birthplace of Christianity and get acquainted with the fascinating history of its formation as state religion in Armenia in 301. During the next stop in Tsaghkadzor visits of Kecharis monastic complex and a cable car to go up the slope of Mount Teghenis (from where there opens a picturesque view of the mountain ranges of the region) are foreseen.

title: Lake Sevan, Hayravank, Noratus, Khachkar carving master class, Mikayelyan Family Farm
description: It's an enjoyable private tour during which first you will have a short stop near Lake Sevan – one of the largest freshwater high-altitude lakes in Eurasia. Visit Hayravank monastery, which according to the constructional solutions, has gained its place among the 9th century architectural pillars. Next, you will see the most original manifestation of Armenian medieval culture – cross-stones, visiting Noratus. By the way, Armenian cross-stones art is included in UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. Also you will have an amazing opportunity to try carving cross-stones (khachkar in Armenian) on your own during an engaging master class. Last, learn about Armenian cheesemaking process, traditions, taste various cheese types at "Mikayelyan" Family Farm.

title: Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery, Manukyan wine factory, Lake Sevan, Sevanavank Monastery
description: Embark on a full-day journey through Armenia’s cultural and natural gems. Begin with a visit to the iconic Garni Pagan Temple, a stunning example of classical Hellenistic architecture. Continue to the awe-inspiring Geghard Monastery, partially carved into the rock and surrounded by dramatic cliffs. Enjoy a warm welcome and wine tasting at the Manukyan Wine Factory, where traditional Armenian winemaking is brought to life with rich flavors. Afterward, take in the breathtaking beauty of Lake Sevan, one of the largest high-altitude freshwater lakes in the world. Explore the historic Sevanavank Monastery, perched on a peninsula with panoramic views of the sparkling lake. This tour offers a perfect blend of history, nature, and authentic Armenian hospitality.

title: Garni Temple, Lavash baking master class, Geghard Monastery, Lake Sevan, Sevanavank
description: Explore Armenia's rich history and breathtaking landscapes on this unforgettable tour. Start at the Arch of Charents, offering stunning panoramic views of Mount Ararat. Continue to the Garni Temple, an ancient pagan structure dating back to the 1st century AD, a rare gem in Armenia's historical architecture. Experience a hands-on lavash baking master class, where you'll learn the art of making Armenia's iconic traditional flatbread. Visit the UNESCO-listed Geghard Monastery, a remarkable site carved into the cliffs, and immerse yourself in its spiritual atmosphere. Relax by the serene shores of Lake Sevan, one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, before heading to Sevanavank Monastery, located on a peninsula with breathtaking views of the lake and surrounding mountains.

title: Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery, Tsaghkadzor, Ropeway, Kecharis, Lake Sevan, Sevanavank
description: This private tour will be an ideal option for those who have planned a short trip around Armenia for it includes several directions at once. The first stop will be at the only pagan temple in Armenia – Garni. In 20-minutes' drive from the temple, the 13th century Geghard monastic complex, partially carved in the rock and included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List, will amaze you with its splendor. The next stop is in Tsaghkadzor city (translated as valley of flowers), which is considered to be one of the most popular winter resorts of Armenia. It is one of the places of our mountainous country, where the beauty of the nature appears with its whole variety. In Tsaghkadzor there is a chairlift with 5 stations and more than a dozen ski runs. Further on the route is the visit of the "Blue pearl" of Armenia – Lake Sevan. Sevanavank monastery, majestically standing on the peninsula, will open an amazing view of the lake in front of you, shimmering in a palette of blue, emerald and green. Currently a religious seminary functions here which is not readily open to the public.

title: Hiking up Mount Artanish
description: The tour starts by heading to Mount Artanish, standing on the summit of which, you will hold in your hands a golden opportunity of overviewing whole Lake Sevan. Take time to immerse in the beauty of nature and let your thoughts relax...

title: Lake Sevan, Noratus Crosstones, Hayravank Monastery, Sevanavank Monastery
description: This private tour includes visits of attractions along the southern coast of Lake Sevan and its peninsula. One of the hallmarks of Armenian identity is the art of khachkars (cross-stones), and the first stop is foreseen at Noratus open-air museum, where hundreds of unique exhibits are collected, among which one can find very delicate khachkars of 13th-14th centuries. The next on the route is Hayravank monastery, which belongs to the monuments of the 9th century. The highlight of the tour is Sevanavank monastery, located on a peninsula, from where there opens an amazing view of the lake, shimmering in a palette of blue, emerald and green. Currently a religious seminary functions there which is not readily open to the public.

title: Dilijan, Haghartsin Monastery, Goshavank Monastery
description: During this private tour you will visit Dilijan, also called "Armenian Switzerland" for its fantastic natural forests. The city is part of the Dilijan National Park. You will stop at the 10th century Haghartsin monastery, which has been recently renovated by donation of Sheikh Dr. Sultan Bin Mohammad Al Qassimi, the Ruler of Sharjah, who was impressed by the monastery when visiting it. At the end of the tour there will be a visit of wonderful Goshavank monastery, surrounded by green forests.

title: Khor Virap Monastery, Lake Sevan, Sevanavank Monastery
description: This interesting journey will take you to the foot of Ararat Mount, where the magnificent Khor Virap monastery is located, and from where there opens a breathtaking view of the Biblical mountain (in cloudless weather). You will appear at the birthplace of Christianity and get acquainted with the fascinating history of its formation as state religion in Armenia in 301. The next stop is  Lake Sevan – the "Blue pearl" of the country. It is one of the largest freshwater high altitude lakes in Eurasia. The stop is foreseen at the peninsula, where magnificently stands Sevanavank monastery. From the height there opens an amazing view of the lake, shimmering in a palette of blue, emerald and green. Currently a religious seminary functions here which is not readily open to the public.

title: Hiking from Lake Parz (Crystal) to Goshavank Monastery
description: An awesome selection of a private tour around Tavush province with the visit of Lake Parz (Crystal), formed due to natural climatic changes, standing for quite a popular destination among tourists. Nature lovers will find this very hiking truly awesome, as the route passes across montane forest. One is, for sure, going to enjoy the atmosphere and time spent in Dilijan National Park.

title: Hiking up Mount Armaghan
description: A wondrous private tour will lead to Mount Armaghan, hiking to which is simply a great way to get absorbed from the stressed routine in the company of peaceful nature. Restore your body and soul, feel the power of energy.

title: Gyumri, Black Fortress, Gyumri Urban Life (Dzitoghtsyan) Museum, Marmashen Monastery
description: This private tour is dedicated to the visit of Gyumri – the second largest city in Armenia and one of the main cultural centers of the Republic. Recently the only Catholic church in Armenia has been built here. By visiting the Museum of Urban Life, you will get acquainted with the daily life, culture and history of Gyumri. There will be a stop near the Black fortress, one of the most famous monuments in Gyumri. Built in 1834, it is included in the list of intangible monuments of history and culture of the city. Walking along the streets, you will pass by numerous old buildings and feel the spirit of 19th century architecture. The exceptional architecture and majesty of Marmashen church will not leave their spectators indifferent during the next stop.

title: Dilijan, Yell Extreme Park
description: Little Armenia is able to surprise you with diversity of its nature. On the way to Dilijan (one of the heavenly corners of our country), passing Gegharkunik province, you will be greeted by the princely forests of Tavush. The first stop is in the cozy and ambient part of the city – at the old street of Dilijan. In an hour you will arrive at "Yell Extreme Park" (Yenokavan village), where it will be possible to order all sorts of activities: from zorbing to zip line flights. It's a convenient option of a tour for lovers of active rest.

title: Hiking to Smbataberd fortress
description: During this private tour you will drive to Yeghegis village, from where the hiking starts to Smbataberd fortress. The latter has served as the most important defensive structure of its time. The ruins of the citadel, living quarters, and also reservoirs have remained to this day.

title: Lake Sevan, Dilijan, Haghartsin, Tolma making master class, Ijevan wine-brandy factory
description: Add bright colors to your day by taking this private tour! First there comes the short visit of Lake Sevan – pearl of our mountainous country and one of the largest freshwater high-altitude lakes in Eurasia. Afterwards the road will take you to Dilijan – the so-called "Armenian Switzerland", where you will see the 10th century Haghartsin monastery, which has been recently renovated by donation of Sheikh Dr. Sultan Bin Mohammad Al Qassimi, the Ruler of Sharjah, who was impressed by the monastery when visiting it. You will, then, have the chance to participate in cooking master class of delicious Armenian national dish at one of the marvelous restaurants of Dilijan. The last point of the tour will be "Ijevan" wine-brandy factory, where tour and tasting of wine are foreseen. The subtle savour of Armenian wine will serve as great ending of the tour.

title: Aruch Cathedral, Marmashen, Gyumri, Urban Life (Dzitoghtsyan) Museum, Harichavank
description: It's a rich in program private tour, during which you will learn the mesmerizing stories of centuries-old Armenia. First there will be the visit of one of the largest churches of the 7th century – Aruch, for which only the open sky serves as a dome, and the ruins around which testify to the rather lively past of this location. The exceptional architecture and majesty of Marmashen church will not leave their spectators indifferent during the next stop. A sightseeing tour of Gyumri, one of the main cultural centers of the republic, includes a walk along the streets of the city, where you will see number of ancient buildings and feel the spirit of 19th century architecture. Harichavank monastic complex, the final stop, is located on the western slope of Mount Aragats, on a rocky promontory.

title: Makaravank Monastery, Berkri Gastro Yard, Yell Extreme Park
description: Discover the hidden treasures of Armenia on this enriching private tour, thoughtfully designed to combine cultural exploration, local flavors and outdoor adventure. Begin your journey with a visit to the serene and lesser-known Makaravank Monastery, a remarkable 10th-13th-century architectural complex nestled in the forested hills, offering a peaceful retreat and a glimpse into Armenia's spiritual heritage. Continue your experience at Berkri Gastro Yard, where you'll be treated to a warm local welcome and an authentic wine tasting session. Savor a selection of fine Armenian wines, paired with local delicacies, and learn about the rich traditions of winemaking in the Tavush region. The tour also includes a stop at Yell Extreme Park, Armenia's first adventure park, where you'll have free time to choose from a variety of adrenaline-pumping activities: zip-lining, off-roading, rope courses and more. Whether you're seeking cultural depth, culinary pleasure, or outdoor excitement, this tour offers a perfect blend for an unforgettable day in Armenia.

title: Dilijan, Lake Parz (Crystal), Makaravank Monastery, Ijevan wine-brandy factory
description: Explore the natural beauty and cultural heritage of Armenia's Tavush region on this scenic tour. Stroll through the charming town of Dilijan, often called the "Armenian Switzerland", known for its lush forests and traditional architecture. Visit Lake Parz, a serene alpine lake surrounded by dense woodlands, perfect for relaxation and stunning photos. Discover the medieval Makaravank Monastery, an architectural gem hidden in the mountains, adorned with intricate stone carvings. Conclude with a visit to the Ijevan wine-brandy factory, where you’ll learn about Armenia's winemaking traditions and enjoy a tasting of locally produced wines and brandy.

title: Haghpat Monastery, Sanahin Monastery
description: Lasting almost a full day, this private tour will at the same time turn into an indescribably positive experience. Both sites are included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List and are at approximately three hours' drive from Yerevan. The first stop is provided at the majestic 10th century monastery Haghpat, where at the end of the 18th century the famous ashug Sayat-Nova lived and created. On your next stop at Sanahin monastery, you will join the 10th century skillfullness of the masters, who made such a peculiar architectural decision – thus, preventing the destruction of the complex from possible earthquakes.

title: Haghpat Monastery, Sanahin Monastery, Odzun Monastery
description: This private tour lasts almost whole day, yet it will serve as an unforgettable & positive experience. The sites are at about three hours' drive from Yerevan. The first stop is at the majestic Haghpat monastery of the 10th century. The famous ashug Sayat-Nova used to live and create there at the end of the 18th century. Next up is Sanahin monastery, where you will join the 10-century skillfullness of the architects, who made a peculiar architectural decision, thus preventing the destruction of the complex from possible earthquakes. Both monastic complexes are included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. The pearl of the tour will be the last stop – the 6th century Odzun monastery, surrounded by picturesque mountain ranges.

title: Haghpat Monastery, Sanahin Monastery, Akhtala Fortress
description: During this long-lasting and engaging private tour first visit is foreseen at the majestic 10th century monastery Haghpat, where at the end of the 18th century the famous ashug Sayat-Nova lived and created. On your next stop at Sanahin monastery, you will join the 10th century skilfulness of the masters, who made such a peculiar architectural decision – thus, preventing the destruction of the complex from possible earthquakes. Both sites are included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List and are considered as "gems" of Lori provice. And last you are going to see the magnificent Akhtala monastery, comprised of three churches, located in the territory of the eponymous fortress. After this trip true inspiration is never going to leave you!

title: Haghpat, Zarni-Parni Cave Castle Complex, Akhtala Fortress, Aramyants Castle, Sanahin
description: Lasting almost a whole day, this tour will at the same time turn into an indescribably positive experience. It is dedicated to the visit of Lori province. You will first admire 10th century monastery Haghpat, where at the end of the 18th century the famous ashug Sayat-Nova lived and created. Next on the route, see the magnificent Zarni-Parni Cave Castle Complex, where, according to historical records, renowned scholar and philosopher Hovhannes Imastaser used to live and work. Currently the area is turned into a historical museum, where one can find number of rare ancient agricultural tools and household items. Afterwards, have a drive to Akhtala fortress, constructed on a plateau resembling a peninsula, surrounded with deep gorges from three sides. Visit Aramyants Castle, one of the jewels of Swiss architecture in Armenia. Last in the schedule is Sanahin monastery, where you will join the 10th century skillfullness of the masters, who made such a peculiar architectural decision – thus, preventing the destruction of the complex from possible earthquakes. By the way, both Haghpat and Sanahin monasteries are included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List.

title: Natural adventures through Armenia in 2 days with rafting on the Debed river
description: A breathtaking 2 day private tour to immerse in the beauty of Armenia! On the first day see Armenian Alphabet Alley – a beautiful demonstration of the stone carvings of 39 Armenian letters, located at the east side bottom of Mount Aragats, in the village of Artashavan. Next on the route, visit Dendropark – the only garden in Southern Caucasus, that was transformed from a forest into an arboretum. Observe Lori Berd fortress, founded in the 11th century and located at the intersection of Lori's picturesque gorges. The overnight is foreseen in the village of Haghpat. The second day starts with full of adrenaline and unforgettable experience – rafting on Debed river. By the way, rafing is gradually becoming one of the most popular activities of extreme tourism in Armenia. On the way back visit Zarni-Parni cave castle complex in a forest canyon with a magnificent view of the Kayan fortress.

title: Armenia's historical and scenic highlights in 2 days
description: We offer you to cover some of the most popular and stunning sites in the direction of North of Yerevan with an overnight stay in the legendary Dilijan. To see the pearl of Armenia – Lake Sevan, on the peninsula of which Sevanavank monastic complex is majestically erected. Observe the sites of Dilijan National Park – Haghartsin and Goshavank monasteries, which amaze with their architecture combined with picturesque nature. The second day includes visits of Lori province sites with stops at the monasteries included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List: Sanahin and Haghpat. And, finally, visit Akhtala fortress, surrounded by gorge from three sides.

title: Lake Sevan, Hayravank, Noratus Crosstones, Selim Caravanserai, Hin Areni wine factory, Jermuk, Waterfall
description: During this tour, visit Hayravank, from where you can enjoy a wonderful view of the "blue pearl" of Armenia – Lake Sevan. The next stop will be at the collection of khachkars in Noratus, which are considered the highlights of Armenian architecture. Then you will pass through the Selim Pass, which connects the northern part of Armenia with the southern one. You will visit the Hin Areni winery, where you will taste the unique Armenian wine. Then you will go to the resort town of Jermuk, which is famous for its mineral waters, which have various healing properties. Also in Jermuk you will see a waterfall with the original name "Mermaid's Hair".

title: Tatev Monastery, Wings of Tatev Ropeway
description: This long journey passes through two provinces – Ararat and Vayots Dzor, heading to the Syunik "kingdom", where the majestic and unique Tatev monastery complex is located. Once the complex served as a spiritual center and had an outstanding scientific and political significance. The monastery is located near the gorge and is surrounded by picturesque nature. It is here that you will have the opportunity to take the longest reversible cableway in the world – "Tatever".

title: Hin Areni wine factory, Shaki Waterfall, Tatev Monastery, Ropeway
description: This private tour will take you to the inspiring and impressive sites of Armenia in southeastern direction. The first stop is going to be in the old village Areni, where a 6000-year-old winery was found. You will enjoy here wine tasting and a tour around "Hin Areni" factory. Next is Shaki waterfall, located in one of the coziest and nicest corners of Syunik province, gloriously opening its striking beauty to all the admirers. Further on the route there comes a flight on the longest reversible cableway in the World – "Wings of Tatev" and a visit of the unique Tatev monastery complex.

title: Hin Areni wine factory, Shaki Waterfall, Tatev Monastery, Ropeway, Karahunj Observatory
description: This private tour will take you to the inspiring and impressive sites of Armenia in southeastern direction. The first stop is going to be in the old village Areni, where a 6000-year-old winery was found. You will enjoy here wine tasting and a tour around "Hin Areni" factory. On the way back to Yerevan you will visit the ancient observatory Karahunj. The petroglyphs (paintings on rocks), found nearby, indicate that primitive man in Armenia had certain information about astronomy.

title: Khor Virap Monastery, Hin Areni wine factory, Noravank Monastery, Tatev Monastery, Ropeway
description: During this tour you will visit Khor Virap monastery – a great place to enjoy the most picturesque views of Mount Ararat. The next stop is the old village Areni, where a 6000-year-old winery was found. You will enjoy here wine tasting and a tour around "Hin Areni" factory. This will be followed by the visit of Noravank monastic complex, which is magnificent in its construction, as the church of Holy Mother of God is 2-storied monastery. The last stop is near Tatev monastery – spiritual center that once had scientific and political importance. The monastery is surrounded by wonderful nature. It is here that you will have the opportunity to ride on the longest reversible cableway in the World – "Tatever".

title: Noravank Monastery, Tatev Monastery, Ropeway, Karahunj Observatory
description: During this tour we suggest covering some of the most interesting sites of the southeastern part of Armenia: to begin with the visit of Noravank monastic complex, which is magnificent in its construction, as the church of Holy Mother of God is 2-storied monastery. Further along the route there will be a stop near Tatev monastery – once a spiritual center with an outstanding scientific and political significance. The monastery is surrounded by picturesque nature. It is here that you will have the opportunity to ride on the longest reversible cableway in the World – "Tatever". On the way back to Yerevan you will visit the ancient observatory Karahunj. The petroglyphs (paintings on rocks), found nearby, indicate that primitive man in Armenia had certain information about astronomy.

title: Hin Areni wine factory, Tatev Monastery, Ropeway, Khndzoresk Caves
description: This tour includes some of the most breathtaking sites of Armenia in southeastern direction. The first stop will be in the old village Areni, where a 6000-year-old winery was found. You will enjoy here wine tasting and a tour around "Hin Areni" factory. Further on the route there comes a flight on the longest reversible cableway in the World – "Wings of Tatev" and a visit of the unique Tatev monastery complex. Yet another impressive stop will be at Khndzoresk cave city, where the bravests can walk along the swinging bridge in search of adrenaline.

title: Tbilisi City Tour (main sights of old and new city)
description: Yerevan and Tbilisi – the two Christian capitals of the Transcaucasus, are located at a distance of ~300 km from each other, which allows travelers to plan a visit to two countries at once within one trip. This tour includes the key landmarks of Tbilisi. Taking the cable car (optional), the whole city will open in front of you in all its splendor. The visit of the old city of Tbilisi will not leave you indifferent, here you will surely notice the signature of Armenian architecture.

title: Uncover northern beauties of Armenia in 3 days
description: Within this 3 days/2 night tour you will have a chance to explore the perfect beauties of the North part of Armenia. The highlights of your trip will be Tsaghkadzor town with Kecharis monastery complex, a ride on the ropeway, visit of the pearl of this mountainous country Lake Sevan, Dilijan town with amazing monastic complexes; Akhtala fortress, constructed on a plateau resembling a peninsula, surrounded with deep gorges from three sides, Haghpat and Sanahin monasteries included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List, 13th century Kobayr monastery, the second largest city in Armenia – Gyumri; Harichavank monastery, situated on the western slope of Mount Aragats; medieval fortress Dashtadem, and, finally, built in the 7th century Aruch Cathedral.

title: Haghpat Monastery, Sanahin Monastery, main sights of Tbilisi
description: Lasting a full day, this private tour will turn into an indescribably positive experience. The first two sites of the route are included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List and are at approximately three hours' drive from Yerevan. See the majestic 10th century monastery Haghpat, where at the end of the 18th century the famous ashug Sayat-Nova lived and created. Visit Sanahin monastery on your next stop and marvel at the 10th century skillfullness of the masters, who made such a peculiar architectural decision – thus, preventing the destruction of the complex from possible earthquakes. This tour also includes the key landmarks of Tbilisi. Taking the cable car (optional), the whole city will open in front of you in all its splendor. The visit of the old city of Tbilisi will not leave you indifferent, here you will surely notice the signature of Armenian architecture.

title: Lake Sevan, Sevanavank, Dilijan, Haghartsin, main sights of Tbilisi
description: A brilliant tour covering Armenia-Georgia. Start with the visit of one of the largest freshwater high altitude lakes in Eurasia. The stop is foreseen at the peninsula, where magnificently stands Sevanavank monastery. From the height there opens an amazing view of the lake, shimmering in a palette of blue, emerald and green. Currently a religious seminary functions here which is not readily open to the public. The route will continue in the direction of Dilijan, called "Armenian Switzerland" for its fantastic natural forests. You will stop at the 10th century Haghartsin monastery, which has been recently renovated by donation of Sheikh Dr. Sultan Bin Mohammad Al Qassimi, the Ruler of Sharjah, who was impressed by the monastery when visiting it. This tour includes the key landmarks of Tbilisi. Taking the cable car (optional), the whole city will open in front of you in all its splendor. The visit of the old city of Tbilisi will not leave you indifferent, here you will surely notice the signature of Armenian architecture. After all those visits, you will return to Armenia with most positive memories!

title: The unique invitation to explore Armenia and Georgia in 2 days
description: A brilliant tour covering Armenia-Georgia. Start the first day with the visit of one of the largest freshwater high altitude lakes in Eurasia. The stop is foreseen at the peninsula, where magnificently stands Sevanavank monastery. From the height there opens an amazing view of the lake, shimmering in a palette of blue, emerald and green. Currently a religious seminary functions here which is not readily open to the public. The route will continue in the direction of Dilijan, called "Armenian Switzerland" for its fantastic natural forests. The overnight is going to be in Tbilisi, the capital city of Georgia. The next day includes tour around the key landmarks of the city, taking a cable car (optional) to observe Tbilisi in all its splendor. The visit of the old city will surely not leave you indifferent, here you will easily notice the signature of Armenian architecture. Next up, admire Mtskheta, the first capital of Christian Georgia, located at the mix-point of Kura and Aragvi rivers. Svetitskhoveli temple of 11th century will amaze you by its magnificence. As a part of Mtskheta city, Jvari (Holy Cross) monastery, built in the first half of the 7th century, is included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. After all those visits, you will return to Armenia with most positive memories!

title: Cultural treasures of Armenia and Georgia in 2 days
description: A delightful 2-day private tour for discovering the unique sites of interest of Armenia and Georgia. On the first day visit monasteries, included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List – the majestic 10th century Haghpat, where at the end of the 18th century the famous ashug Sayat-Nova lived and created and Sanahin, where you will join the 10th century skilfulness of the masters, who made such a peculiar architectural decision – thus, preventing the destruction of the complex from possible earthquakes. Next, head to Tbilisi, the capital city of Georgia, for having an overnight. The second day starts with exploring the key landmarks of the city and taking a cable car (optional) to observe Tbilisi in all its splendor. The old part of the city will surely not leave you indifferent, here you will easily notice the signature of Armenian architecture. Admire Mtskheta, the first capital of Christian Georgia, located at the mix-point of Kura and Aragvi rivers. Svetitskhoveli temple of 11th century will amaze you by its magnificence. As a part of Mtskheta city, Jvari (Holy Cross) monastery, built in the first half of the 7th century, is included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. Return to Armenia full of energy and glorious memories!

title: Epic journey through Armenia in 2 days
description: This 2-day trip will guide you through the southeastern direction and the ancient trade routes of Armenia. The sites planned for the first day amaze with their architecture, being harmoniously surrounded by picturesque nature: Khor Virap monastery against the backdrop of the sacred Mount Ararat; the magnificent 2-storied monastery Noravank, contrasting with brick-red rocks, Tatev monastery – once of scientific and political importance, surrounded by the Vorotnavank gorge. Among the activities planned there are flight on the longest reversible cableway in the World – "Tatever" and wine tasting at "Hin Areni" wine factory. After the overnight in Goris, the first stop will be at Karahunj ancient observatory. Visitors of the resort town Jermuk will be lucky to feel harmony with nature, drink mineral water of various temperatures, as well as relax listening to the melody of the waterfall. Further along the route there is a stop at a caravanserai, built in the 14th century for travelers carrying their goods to the West. At the end of the tour you will have an overview of the picturesque Lake Sevan from the peninsula where Sevanavank monastery is located. The whole trip is of long duration, thus you should schedule the tours to start early in the morning.

title: The best of Armenia and Georgia in 2 days
description: A nice 2-day private tour Armenia-Georgia, including the most inspiring sites of interest of both countires. During the first day visit Gyumri, the most colorful city in Armenia from the ethnical point of view. The local traditions are deeply rooted here, national spirit is reflected in everything. See Yot verk and All saviors churches, also learn the most popular traditions and customs of Armenians at the Museum of National Architecture and Urban Life, included in the list of intangible monuments of history and culture of Gyumri. Next up, head to Georgia for visiting Vardzia – an incredible site to explore for those interested in history and culture. You will observe the beautiful carved monastery – part of the Vardzia Historical Architectural Museum Reserve in the cave town, founded in the 12th century. Afterwards, have overnight in Borjomi resort town. The second day starts with the visit of the famous mineral springs of Borjomi, having restorative and healing powers. Up next, go see Tbilisi, the capital of Georgia with the key landmarks of the city, also take a cable car (optional) to observe Tbilisi in all its splendor. The visit of the old city will surely not leave you indifferent, here you will easily notice the signature of Armenian architecture. Come back to Armenia full of inspiring memories!

title: Taste and flavour of charming Georgia in 2 days from Yerevan
description: This private tour is an ideal option to get acquainted with Georgian cultural heritage! First up, visit Tbilisi, the capital of Georgia with the key landmarks of the city, also take a cable car (optional) to observe Tbilisi in all its splendor. The visit of the old city will surely not leave you indifferent, here you will easily notice the signature of Armenian architecture. Have overnight in Tbilisi. During the next day see Sighnaghi, а small picturesque town in the eastern part of Georgia, founded in the 17th century. The town holds a beautiful story, for which it is called "The City of Love". At the distance of 2 km from Sighnaghi there stands ancient Bodbe nunnery, where the relics of the enlightener of Georgia, St. Nino, rest. The monastery is rather popular among tourists and pilgrims. After all those places visited, your return to Armenia with unforgettable memories is guaranteed.

title: Unforgettable experience from Armenia to Georgia in 3 days
description: This private tour is an ideal option to get acquainted with Georgian cultural heritage! First up, visit Lake Sevan, the pearl of our mountainous country and one of the largest freshwater high-altitude lakes in Eurasia. Afterwards the route heads to Dilijan, also called "Armenian Switzerland" for its fantastic natural forests. The city is part of the Dilijan National Park. You will stop at the 10th century Haghartsin monastery, which has been recently renovated by donation of Sheikh Dr. Sultan Bin Mohammad Al Qassimi, the Ruler of Sharjah, who was impressed by the monastery when visiting it. Visit Tbilisi, the capital of Georgia with the key landmarks of the city, also take a cable car (optional) to observe Tbilisi in all its splendor. The visit of the old city will surely not leave you indifferent, here you will easily notice the signature of Armenian architecture. Have overnight in Tbilisi. At the distance of 2 km from Sighnaghi there stands ancient Bodbe nunnery, where the relics of the enlightener of Georgia, St. Nino, rest. The monastery is rather popular among tourists and pilgrims. Admire Mtskheta, the first capital of Christian Georgia, located at the mix-point of Kura and Aragvi rivers. Svetitskhoveli temple of 11th century will amaze you by its magnificence. As a part of Mtskheta city, Jvari (Holy Cross) monastery, built in the first half of the 7th century, is included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List. After all those places visited, your return to Armenia with unforgettable memories is guaranteed.

title: Six wonderful regions of Armenia in 3 days
description: This 3-day tour perfectly covers some of the most important and attractive sites of several regions of Armenia. Passing through the spectacular roads of Aragatsotn region the route leads to greeny Lori region, where Akhtala fortress, as well as UNESCO heritage sites Haghpat & Sanahin monasteries are welcoming visitors. The overnight though is foreseen in Dilijan city in Tavush region that surprises the guests with its density forests. On the second day observe the sites of Dilijan National Park – Haghartsin and Goshavank monasteries, which amaze with their architecture combined with picturesque nature. And see the pearl of Armenia – Lake Sevan in Gegharkunik region, on the peninsula of which Sevanavank monastic complex is majestically erected. Passing by Selim Pass you will reach Jermuk city in Vayots Dzor region where the overnight is foreseen. Visitors of the resort town Jermuk will be lucky to feel harmony with nature, drink mineral water of various temperatures, as well as relax listening to the melody of the waterfall. Among the activities in Syunik region planned on this day is the flight on the longest reversible ropeway in the world – "Tatever", which links Halidzor village with once of scientific and political importance Tatev monastery, surrounded by the Vorotan gorge. On the way back to Yerevan there is a stop at one of the most important site – Noravank monastery that contrasts with brick-red rocks.
